audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer chart read Taliyah / Skill x6 while the content layer read Skill, Taliyah, Taliyah, Taliyah, Galio, Taliyah, Galio. The two layers disagreed on all seven rows.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches the content layer exactly, so the full layer is the stale one. Taliyah leads levels 2-5 on range (Threaded Volley 1000 vs your 825) and Galio takes level 6 and the late grouped fight.
audit.corrected: All seven phases[N].side moved to the content-layer verdict with ratings and whys rewritten. content win[N] already matches on disk, so no content chart edit is needed.

audit.whatIsWrong: content whys[6] and the `late` prose both said Taliyah stays favoured late, while win[6] on the same page says Galio. The row argued with the sentence under it.
audit.why: win[6] and packet.levelChart[6] are both Galio. Weaver's Wall is 180/150/120 — it is a roam and escape tool on a long cooldown, not a teamfight answer to a 4000+ range knock-up.
audit.corrected: whys[6] and `late` rewritten to give the grouped late fight to Galio while keeping her side-lane roam advantage intact.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states the decisive interaction: Unraveled Earth stuns enemies who dash through it, and both Threaded Volley and Seismic Shove carry grounding. Galio's entire engage is a dash.
audit.why: enemyKit: E text says 'If enemies dash through it or are knocked through it, the mines explode and stun them'; Q and W both carry the grounding flag. Justice Punch is Galio's only gap-close (650 range, 11s at rank 1), so grounding or a live minefield removes his whole pattern.
audit.corrected: breakdown.early, breakdown.cooldowns, phases[2].why, phases[3].why and dontsFull[2].d now all state it: do not dash into Unraveled Earth, and expect to be grounded off Threaded Volley.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit (lint COOLDOWN_NO_DIGIT), and dosFull[2].d claimed a 'fifteen-second' Seismic Shove.
audit.why: Seismic Shove is 14/12.5/11/9.5/8. Unraveled Earth is a flat 14s. Weaver's Wall is 180/150/120.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written into breakdown.cooldowns; the invitation corrected to fourteen seconds.

edits.before: Late: her map-wide roam speed and disengage tools outpace your ability to pin her down, so she stays favoured overall.
edits.after: Late: grouped fights suit you — Weaver's Wall is 120s and cannot pull her out once Hero's Entrance lands on her team.

edits.before: Unfortunately her roam speed and wall-based repositioning keep paying off into the late game — she can pressure side lanes and reposition out of skirmishes faster than you can track her down, and her poke chips your frontline before fights even start. Unless your ultimate lands on a grouped fight where she can't easily disengage through terrain, she keeps the edge in most late-game skirmishes.
edits.after: Her roam speed and wall-based repositioning keep paying off in the side lanes — she can pressure and reposition out of skirmishes faster than you can track her down, and her poke chips your frontline before the fight even starts. But the grouped 5v5 is yours: Weaver's Wall is a 120s cooldown at rank 3 and cannot pull her out of the circle once Hero's Entrance lands.
